ja: 私は、こんなお願いはめったにしない。
en: Rarely do I ask for favors like this.
alternatives: I rarely ask for favors like this.
I hardly ever ask for favors like this.
point: Rarely を前に出すと do が主語の前へ

ja: サムにやり直してと頼んだ。
en: I asked Sam to redo it.
alternatives: I asked Sam to do it again.
I asked Sam to try again.
point: ask + 人 + to do の語順

ja: 明日、代わりに出られる？
en: Can you cover for me tomorrow?
alternatives: Could you cover for me tomorrow?
Can you fill in for me tomorrow?
point: 代わりを務めるは cover for ~

ja: 断っていれば、今は暇なのに。
en: If I'd refused, I'd be free now.
alternatives: If I'd said no, I'd be free now.
Had I said no, I'd be free now.
point: 過去の仮定 + 今の結果は would be

ja: 返事、ずっと待ってます。
en: I've been waiting for your reply.
alternatives: I've been waiting to hear back.
I've been waiting on your reply.
point: 続いている動作は have been ~ing

ja: 今、彼に連絡中です。
en: I'm contacting him now.
alternatives: I'm reaching out to him now.
I'm getting in touch with him.
point: 「今〜している」は am + -ing。連絡する contact

ja: 共有してくれてれば、手伝ったのに。
en: If you'd looped me in, I'd have helped.
alternatives: Had you looped me in, I'd have helped.
If you'd told me, I'd have helped.
If you'd kept me posted, I'd have helped.
point: 「共有する」は loop ~ in。過去の仮定は had done

ja: 私が曖昧に頼んでたら君は今も手探りだ。
en: Had I equivocated, you'd still be flying blind.
alternatives: If I'd been evasive, you'd still lack essential guidance.
You'd still be working without guidance if I'd equivocated.
point: equivocate は言葉を濁す、fly blind は情報なしに進める。

ja: お言葉に甘えられたらいいのですが。
en: I wish I could take you up on that.
alternatives: I wish I could take you up on it.
I wish I could accept your offer.
point: take ~ up on は申し出を受ける

ja: この件を引き受ける余裕はない。
en: I can't afford to take this on.
alternatives: I don't have the capacity to take this on.
I don't have the bandwidth for this.
point: can't afford to + 動詞で「〜する余裕がない」

ja: 頼みたいのは、第三者の目です。
en: What I need is fresh eyes.
alternatives: What I'm after is a second pair of eyes.
It's a second pair of eyes I need.
point: 「別の人の目」は a second pair of eyes

ja: 彼が無理と言ったら、こっそり教えて。
en: Tip me off if he says he can't.
alternatives: Give me a heads-up if he says he can't.
Let me know early if he says he can't.
point: 「こっそり知らせる」は tip off。if 節の中に says 節

ja: 顧客の依頼が一件未処理。
en: There's one outstanding client request.
alternatives: One client request is still pending.
There's one client request awaiting action.
point: outstanding はまだ処理されていない意味もある。

ja: よければ、手伝ってもらえない？
en: I don't suppose you could help?
alternatives: I was wondering if you could help.
Would there be any chance you could help?
point: I don't suppose you could で控えめに頼む

ja: もうお願いしたと思ってた。
en: I thought I'd already asked you.
alternatives: I believed I'd already asked you.
I was under the impression I'd already asked.
point: それ以前の出来事は過去完了

ja: 今、忙しいですか？
en: Are you busy now?
alternatives: Are you busy right now?
Are you free now?
point: 疑問文は Are you の順

ja: 手空きなら私が問合せをさばくのに。
en: If I weren't swamped, I'd field inquiries.
alternatives: If I were free, I'd handle inquiries.
I'd handle inquiries if I weren't busy.
point: field は問い合わせなどを受けて対応すること。

ja: 手が空いたら手伝います。
en: I'll help once I'm free.
alternatives: When I'm available, I'll help.
I'll help when I have time.
point: once の後は未来のことも現在形。

ja: チームに、明日やり直させます。
en: I'll have the team redo it tomorrow.
alternatives: I'll get the team to redo it tomorrow.
I'll have the team do it over tomorrow.
point: have + 人 + 原形で「させる」

ja: この仕事の方が要求が厳しい。
en: This task is more exacting.
alternatives: This task is more demanding.
This assignment demands more.
point: exacting は高い水準を要求する。

ja: 報告書が昼までに必要です。
en: The report is needed by noon.
alternatives: We need the report by noon.
I need the report by noon.
point: 期限は until ではなく by noon

ja: 代わりに、これお願いできますか？
en: Would you mind covering this for me?
alternatives: Could you cover this for me?
Would you mind taking care of this for me?
point: Would you mind の後ろは -ing

ja: 細かな問題を潰してくれますか？
en: Could you iron out the wrinkles?
alternatives: Could you fix the minor issues?
Could you work out the kinks?
point: iron out the wrinkles は細かな問題を解消すること。

ja: ちょっと見ていただけますか？
en: Would you mind taking a look?
alternatives: Could you possibly take a look?
Do you think you could take a look?
point: Would you mind + -ing は丁寧な依頼

ja: 一つお願いがあります。
en: I need a favor.
alternatives: I have a favor to ask.
I'd like to ask a favor.
point: favor は数えられる名詞。a を付ける

ja: やりたいのは山々だけど無理。
en: Much as I'd love to, I can't.
alternatives: As much as I'd love to, I can't.
I'd love to, but I can't.
Much as I'd like to, I can't.
point: 「〜は山々だが」は Much as I'd love to

ja: 頼んだ件、もう終わった？
en: Have you finished what I asked?
alternatives: Did you finish what I asked?
Are you done with what I asked?
point: 現在の結果は現在完了、過去の時点は過去形

ja: 先に一言くれてもよかったのに。
en: You could've given me a heads-up.
alternatives: You could have told me beforehand.
You might have given me some warning.
point: 「〜してくれてもよかった」は could have done

ja: それでいいですよ。
en: That's fine with me.
alternatives: That works for me.
That's okay with me.
point: 「私はいい」は fine with me

ja: 忙しいのを承知でお願いします。
en: Knowing you're busy, I hate asking.
alternatives: I hate to ask, knowing you're busy.
Sorry to ask, knowing how busy you are.
point: Knowing で前置きする分詞構文

ja: 昨日、彼に頼みました。
en: I asked him yesterday.
alternatives: I asked him about it yesterday.
Yesterday I asked him.
point: ask の過去形は asked。yesterday と一緒に使う

ja: もっと早く頼んでほしかったな。
en: I wish you'd asked me sooner.
alternatives: I wish you had asked me earlier.
I wish you'd let me know earlier.
point: 過去の不満は wish + 過去完了

ja: 君が濁してたら私は君の職責を誤解した。
en: Had you hedged, I'd have misread your remit.
alternatives: If you'd been evasive, I'd have misunderstood your role.
I'd have misread your responsibilities if you'd hedged.
point: hedge は曖昧にする、remit は依頼された役割や範囲。

ja: 何かあれば、連絡してください。
en: Should anything come up, call me.
alternatives: If anything comes up, call me.
Let me know if anything comes up.
Should anything happen, contact me.
point: Should + 主語で if を省く倒置

ja: それは私の仕事です。
en: That's my job.
alternatives: That's my responsibility.
It's my job.
point: 「それ」は That。That's は That is の短縮

ja: 話した資料、送ってね。
en: Send the file I mentioned.
alternatives: Please send the file I mentioned.
Send me the file we talked about.
point: file の後ろに I mentioned を置いて資料を特定する

ja: 頼みたいのは、話を聞くことだけです。
en: All I ask is you hear me out.
alternatives: All I'm asking is that you hear me out.
All I want is for you to hear me out.
point: All I ask is that ~ で「望むのは〜だけ」

ja: 今、対応中です。
en: I'm working on it.
alternatives: I'm handling it now.
I'm on it.
point: 「〜中」は am + -ing。work on は「取り組む」

ja: 承認を早められる人、君は分かる？
en: Any idea who could fast-track approval?
alternatives: Do you know who can fast-track approval?
Do you know who can expedite approval?
point: fast-track は通常より迅速に進める。

ja: 助けが必要です。
en: I need some help.
alternatives: I need help.
I need a hand.
point: help は数えられない名詞。a は付けない

ja: 先に彼に聞いたほうがいい。
en: You should ask him first.
alternatives: You'd better ask him first.
I think you should ask him first.
point: 助言は should。first は文末に置く

ja: 顧客の修正依頼を優先して。
en: Prioritize the client's requested revisions.
alternatives: Address the client's requested edits first.
Put the client's requested edits first.
point: prioritize は優先順位を上げること。

ja: 私が明日までにやります。
en: I'll do it by tomorrow.
alternatives: I'll get it done by tomorrow.
I'll finish it by tomorrow.
point: 「〜までに」は by。その場の約束は I'll

ja: 原案はもうご覧になりましたか？
en: Have you seen the draft yet?
alternatives: Have you looked at the draft yet?
Have you had a look at the draft?
point: 「もう」を尋ねる yet は現在完了

ja: 早退してもいいですか？
en: May I leave early?
alternatives: Is it okay if I leave early?
Can I head out early?
point: 許可を求めるときは May I / Is it okay if

ja: 君が求めてるのはほぼ白紙委任だ。
en: What you seek borders on carte blanche.
alternatives: You're asking for almost unrestricted authority.
You're seeking virtually a free hand.
point: border on はほとんど当たる、carte blanche は全面的な裁量。

ja: 彼は穴埋めすると言った。
en: He said he'd pick up the slack.
alternatives: He said he'd cover the missing work.
He said he'd make up the shortfall.
point: pick up the slack は足りない分の仕事を引き受けること。

ja: 君を待ち受ける仕事は過酷だ。
en: Work awaiting you is grueling.
alternatives: The work ahead of you is exhausting.
You face grueling work.
point: awaiting you は後ろからの説明、grueling は非常にきつい。
